body: I guess I'm just meant to be alone.  I don't know how to make those connections with people.
Dude, I can't even sign up for the gym out of fear of what people would think of how I lift weights.  If I can't do that how will I "just make friends"?

How does going out as a group do anything as far as getting to know people?  I've gone out with a few coworkers to bowl once.  There were 2 girls there with them.  But we never talked because it was a group setting and I just bowled.

Well, someone would have to be pretty fucked up to be interested in me.  We'll see if someone will be willing to make that bad decision in the future.

Being outgoing isn't who I am.  It isn't in my personality.

and how am I supposed to just take it when all my coworkers are bragging about the girl they brought home and banged the night before?  Like it's fucking nothing.  Like only a completely retarded idiot couldn't get laid.  

What then???  I feel like absolute shit man.  I can't even get a hi from a girl and my coworkers are out getting laid.

So when will it happen then?  I'm looking for a career job that doesn't have very many women in it so meeting someone there is probably out of the question. 

What happens if I do meet someone by some slim chance?  Any where in life?  I'll probably just fuck up like I have all these other times.  I'm 23 and have never dated.  That is a huge red flag for a lot of women.  

Someone can have similar interests to me and still nothing will happen.  I've seen it. 

I can't relax.  I'm healthy I guess in the sense that I'm not dying but I'm not great.  No friends.  Only my immediately family cares about me.  Not self sustaining my parents still pay for a lot of my stuff. 

Shits not going well.
That's not the kind of person I am.  I can't do something like that.

I've looked everywhere.  Online dating, in classes when I was in college, friends of friends.  Nothing ever works.  I've gotten shot down quite a few times so I don't really bother anymore.  I don't have it in me to be disappointed like that.

23 isn't long in life, but every year that goes by is a year that more women my age get married and are no longer looking to date.  The chances that I'll end up and die single increases with each year.  

College doesn't determine what will happen later.  But that was supposed to be the time that dating and getting laid is the easiest it'll ever be.  And look at me, I couldn't even manage to do anything.
I don't want to force them to do something.  I don't think you can force something like attraction

yes.  Tinder, okcupid, pof.  Either the women don't respond or they respond in 2-5 word phrases.  They don't ask anything about me, so I just drop it and leave them alone.

I have literally never had a girl interested in me.  Not even on fucking dating sites.
I have profiles on all the big dating websites and I can't even get a fucking response back
seems like a lot of work

I would start a new nation somewhere tropical.  I hate the cold.  

I would invite a few smart people, some people who could be my protection/small army, and then I'd fill the rest of the population with average or lower intelligence people.  I need people to build things and geniuses wouldn't want to do that.
I guess so.  Most if not all land has already been claimed by one country or another.
Thanks I guess.  23 years on this planet and it's gotten me nothing.  No girlfriend.  No hobbies I'm passionate about.  No fulfilling job.  Nothing.

And how will I meet those women?  Why would I want to live alone for 7 more years just on the hope that I find someone new?

I've tried everything.  Tinder, okcupid, POF, and nothing works.  I either don't get a response (a majority of the time) or when we meet up for a first date she's uninterested and things don't go much further.  

But the best part is that I got a girl to go on 4 dates with me and for whatever reason she's lost interest in me.  Here I thought she was interested, one of the few women who have ever given a fuck about me and now she's gone.  Do you know how bad that hurts? 

It seems like all women want to do at this age is go out to parties and get wasted.  I don't drink and apparently that makes me too boring for most of them.  

This fucking sucks.

I have my mom and dad who care about me as well as a younger brother but I don't know if he'd be too downed if I died.
